meta.source: Sleeper API draft/picks endpoints plus unofficial api.sleeper.com season projections
notes: actual_price = auction dollars paid (for keepers, the keeper price)
is_keeper = Sleeper flag on the pick
projected_points = Sleeper full-season projection rescored with this league scoring_settings; fetched after each season ended so it may not match the preseason number
adp_half_ppr = Sleeper half-PPR ADP from the same projection record
projected_price_est = my estimate, NOT a Sleeper value: $2,400 budget minus $1 per roster spot split by projected value over replacement (QB13, RB30, WR36, TE13), min $1
price_diff = actual_price - projected_price_est (positive means paid above estimate)
